title: What "Put to Death" Actually Means for the Sin You Keep Managing
caption:
Somewhere along the way, "put to death" turned into "work on it."

Colossians 3:5 doesn't ask you to manage your sin. It asks you to kill it before it kills you. Some sins die in a single confession. Most die daily, one refused moment at a time.

Stop negotiating with what should already be dead.
